description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class for handling the 'Contact' page in an OpenCart e-commerce project. It manages rendering the contact page, processing form submissions, validating input, and showing success messages.

classes.name: Contact
classes.description: Controller class for the Contact page, handling the display and processing of contact forms, including validation, CAPTCHA, and rendering views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the contact page with store info, location maps, CAPTCHA, and other common page components.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates input, triggers email task, and redirects on success.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays the success confirmation page after form submission.
